title: "About"
---

When I came home to Ireland after years in the US, I was struck by how much religious iconography is still everywhere, from statues of Mary outside hospitals to the crucifixes on church steeples I pass as I cycle to work. Churches, nursing homes, HSE facilities and schools, many still marked with religious symbols. It made me wonder how much of this land, and how many of these buildings, the Church still owns, and what it has sold, when and for how much.

I care about this because I have two young children who will grow up in this country. Education, especially in the early years, shapes how we learn and how we come to understand ourselves and the world. Close to 90% of primary schools in Ireland are still under Catholic patronage, and the State's auditor has found that 85% of schools are built on land owned by patrons or trustees. The State pays to build and run these schools, but the land often stays in Church hands.

A lot of excellent journalism and research has been published on this (see the [reading list](reading.qmd)). What's missing is a living map that the public can use, add to and argue over, and that keeps track of what is owned, bought and sold.

The Catholic Church is still one of the biggest landowners in Ireland. Its influence on Irish life has waned, but land still brings money and power. Its holdings are spread across dioceses, parishes, orders, trusts, companies and named individuals, which makes the whole picture hard to see and responsibility easy to avoid. Open Talamh sets out to make that picture visible.

The "open" in Open Talamh is deliberate. This is meant to be a community effort, something journalists, historians, local researchers and anyone curious can use and [contribute to](contribute.qmd). The data, code and [method](method.qmd) are all public.

## Who I am

My name is Maedbh King. I got a PhD in psychology from the University of California, Berkeley, and during that time I spent years [building maps of the human brain](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ie/blog/the-athletes-way/201907/new-maps-the-cerebellum-show-how-our-little-brain-works). Now I'm turning those same research skills to mapping who owns Ireland's land, carefully and in the open.

*Talamh* is Irish for land. You can reach me at [opentalamh@proton.me](mailto:opentalamh@proton.me).
